== Elaida, Teslyn, Duhara, and Javindhra ==

Do we really know which Red Sitters replaced whom? Can someone provide evidence that Duhara replaced Teslyn and Javindhra replaced Elaida? -[[User:Rrius|Rrius]] 18:56, November 16, 2009 (UTC)

:My speciality! LOL! yes, we do. Elaida replaced [[Amira Moselle]] shortly after returning to Tar Valon from Andor. The three red Sitters in the Hall when Elaida was elected were Pevara (mentioned as being a Sitter for 10 years), Teslyn (mentioned as being a Sitter for 15 years) and Elaida herself. Shortly after Elaida is elected, she has a meeting with her cronies. Among them is Javinhra who is specifically mentioned as being a Sitter (this is tFoH prologue, I believe). Teslyn is also present at this meeting. Thus Elaida was replaced by Javindhra. Then Elaida unchairs Teslyn and sends her to Ebou Dar with Joline. Later (tPoD, Unexpected Absences, I think) we see Duhara as a Red Sitter. The only person that she could have replaced is the recently unchaired Teslyn. 

:You could even try to work further back and prove that Amira and Teslyn were likely replacements for two of the three Red Sitters who were exiled by MArith Jean, namely Tsutama, Toviene and Lirene. [[User:Moridin 2000|Moridin_2000]] 04:29, November 17, 2009 (UTC)
::Awesome! Now if you could just tell me why my notes had it backwards, I'd be set! Thanks so much. -[[User:Rrius|Rrius]] 04:51, November 17, 2009 (UTC)
